files.content:
# Sustainable Packaging Brief

Audience: operations managers at ecommerce brands shipping 1,000-15,000 parcels per month.
Primary keyword: sustainable packaging checklist.
Reader intent: practical how-to before choosing packaging vendors.
Seed facts:
- Harbor & Finch cut filler material by 32% after right-sizing mailers.
- Their damage rate stayed under 1.8% during a 60-day pilot.
- Warehouse staff need a packing-station card, not a long policy PDF.
- Finance wants packaging cost tracked per shipped order.
- The CTA should invite teams to run a two-week packaging audit.
